outcomeNote: A chapter-opening mishna stating law; no interaction between parties is recorded here.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ יֵשׁ בַּעֲרָכִין לְהָקֵל וּלְהַחְמִיר, וּבִשְׂדֵה אֲחוּזָּה לְהָקֵל וּלְהַחְמִיר, וּבְשׁוֹר הַמּוּעָד שֶׁהֵמִית הָעֶבֶד לְהָקֵל וּלְהַחְמִיר, בָּאוֹנֵס וּבַמְפַתֶּה וּבַמּוֹצִיא שֵׁם רַע לְהָקֵל וּלְהַחְמִיר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «There are» halakhot «with regard to valuations that are lenient and» others «that are stringent; and» there are halakhot «with regard to an ancestral field that are lenient and» others «that are stringent; and» there are halakhot «with regard to a forewarned ox that killed» a Canaanite «slave that are lenient and» others «that are stringent;» and there are halakhot «with regard to a rapist, and a seducer, and a defamer that are lenient and» others «that are stringent.»

segments.he: יֵשׁ בַּעֲרָכִין לְהָקֵל וּלְהַחְמִיר, כֵּיצַד? אֶחָד שֶׁהֶעֱרִיךְ אֶת הַנָּאֶה שֶׁבְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת הַכָּעוּר שֶׁבְּיִשְׂרָאֵל, נוֹתֵן חֲמִשִּׁים סֶלַע, וְאִם אָמַר: ״הֲרֵי דָּמָיו עָלַי״, נוֹתֵן אֶת שׇׁוְויוֹ.
segments.en: «There are» halakhot «with regard to valuations that are lenient and» others «that are stringent; how so? Both» in the case of one «who took» a vow of «valuation» to donate the fixed value «of the» most «attractive among the Jewish people and» in the case of one who took a vow of valuation to donate the fixed value of «the» most «unsightly among the Jewish people, he gives» the fixed payment of «fifty sela,» shekels, to the Temple treasury (see Leviticus 27:3). «And if» one «said: It» is incumbent «upon me» to donate the «assessment» of another to the Temple treasury, «he gives the price» for that person if sold as a slave, a sum that can be more or less than fifty shekels.

moves.summary: lists the four areas with both lenient and stringent halakhot
spells out the case of valuations: fifty sela for anyone, but assessment follows worth
